bounded_claims.falsification_rule: Falsified if any of 30 controlled eight-writer trials using stale read-filter-rebind snapshots retains all eight writes, or if the locked control loses any write.
bounded_claims.hypothesis: A checkpoint collector that lets parallel writers read a shared result set and later rebind it from stale snapshots can silently lose completed agent writes; one lock spanning read, filter, rebind, and append prevents loss in the same controlled schedule.

bounded_claims.falsification_rule: Falsified if a memory-only result is available by durable path after worker exit in any of 12 trials, or if any atomically written control result cannot be read back with its expected SHA-256.
bounded_claims.hypothesis: A provider-completed receipt is insufficient custody evidence: a worker result held only in process memory disappears on exit, while an atomically written result survives and can be hash-verified.

commission_hypothesis: Published agent failure postmortems reveal recurrent result-loss mechanisms reproducible in the factory.
